kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem refresh-data-source --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1130916744880000 --data-source-id ds-jl67vixpe1scwysgyu3x --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RefreshDataSource

parameters.help_en:
The region where the threat analysis data management center is located. Specify the management center region based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Your assets are located in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Your assets are located outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the received message. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.
en: English.

Note: This parameter is required in actual calls. If this parameter is not specified, the service returns a 400 error "The specified Lang can not be empty." Explicitly pass in the language code
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文

注意：此参数在实际调用中为必填项；未提供时服务返回 400 错误 “The specified Lang can not be empty.”，请显式传入语言代码
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for
